mealAnalysis.guidance_message: This meal appears to be fresh kiwi fruit, which is a whole fruit with fiber and a relatively moderate effect on blood sugar levels compared with refined carbohydrate foods. For someone with diabetes, it is generally a lower-glycemic fruit option when eaten in a modest portion; whole fruit is preferable to juice or sweetened fruit products.
mealAnalysis.meal_description: Two kiwi fruit halves, representing approximately one whole fresh kiwi served raw.
